request.description: Every flight on the date (plus the flex window): flight number, local departure/arrival times, UTC times, duration, fare classes, seats left. Use this when a route has more than one frequency per day and the cheapestPerDay times are not enough. FlexDaysBeforeOut/FlexDaysOut widen the window; ToUs=AGREED is required.
Array of YYYY-MM-DD strings the route actually operates on. Cheap pre-filter before hitting fare or availability endpoints.
